propositions: The autouse _no_repo_commits guard invokes git rev-parse HEAD before and after every test, causing ~207 runner-seconds / 75s projected wall-time overhead on the full test suite.

Proposed in-process HEAD fingerprint approach requires either adding a Git library (Dulwich/pygit2), hand-parsing ref formats, or removing per-test checkout attribution, none of which meets both fidelity preservation and automatic-approval consensus criteria.
Four surveyed OSS projects (pytest, pip, Poetry, pre-commit) achieve test isolation without per-test source-checkout Git subprocesses, establishing directional consensus against the current approach.
The ticket was moved to blocked/wontfix by operator disposition 2026-08-19 due to lack of consensus on any safe, fidelity-preserving implementation primitive.
